deployments_detail.use: KEPCO Energy AI Partners platform (launched May 2024); 3-phase energy-AI roadmap (data integration from 2026); AI Innovation Division
Partnership with OpenAI (MOU signed June 26, 2026) to drive AI transformation across the energy sector, adopting AI to modernize power industry operations. [OpenAI]
Virtual Grid: a generative-AI-based cyber replica (digital twin) of the actual power grid to run system simulations and improve network operating efficiency.
IDPP (real-time power generation data analysis and prediction platform): AI platform for real-time analysis and forecasting of power generation data.

SK AX partnership with KEPCO Engineering & Construction (KEPCO E&C) to apply AI ('AX' AI transformation) across the power generation/engineering process, including power plant design and related operations. [SK AX]
MOU with Emirates Nuclear Energy Company (ENEC) to expand cooperation in advanced nuclear technologies and artificial intelligence for nuclear energy.

AI Data Centers: conversion of KEPCO's existing ICT data centers in Naju and Daejeon into AI data centers with incrementally expanded GPU resources, providing open AI infrastructure for the energy innovation ecosystem.

AI wildfire detection on transmission infrastructure: cameras (50x zoom, thermal) on transmission towers and cell sites analyze imagery with a hard-vote ensemble of models plus environmental sensors to detect wildfire smoke at 99%+ accuracy, trained on 840,000 fire/smoke images; deployed at 25 tower/cell sites across 3 provinces with planned nationwide rollout to ~20,000 sites. Won Korean government President's Award in 2023.
deployments_detail.value: 99%+ detection accuracy; 840,000 training images; 25 sites deployed across 3 provinces
